tips.preCondition: Pre-condition your cabin while plugged in to reduce HVAC battery drain.
tips.coastMore: Coast more by lifting your foot earlier before stops.
tips.tirePressure: Keep tire pressure at recommended levels for better efficiency.
tips.smoothAccel: Accelerate gradually — aim for steady pedal pressure.
tips.regenBraking: Use regenerative braking instead of the brake pedal when possible.
tips.followDistance: Maintain a larger following distance to avoid sudden braking.
tips.speedLimit: Stay within the speed limit — aerodynamic drag rises exponentially above 90 km/h.
tips.cruiseControl: Use Autopilot or cruise control on highways for consistent speed.
tips.routePlanning: Plan routes to avoid high-speed stretches when possible.
